news.title: Purnia University Students Demand Resumption of Clinical Nutrition and Dietetics Course
news.author: 90I संवाददाता
news.excerpt:
Purnia: Growing dissatisfaction has been reported among students regarding the Clinical Nutrition and Dietetics course at Purnia University. In this regard, students associated with the course have submitted a written application to the Vice-Chancellor, urging the university to restart the programme.
The students said that the course is directly linked to their careers, employment opportunities and future prospects. Therefore, discontinuing the course or keeping its status uncertain would be against their interests.
In their application, the students stated that Clinical Nutrition and Dietetics is a vocational programme related to the healthcare sector, and its importance has increased significantly in recent years. There is a growing demand for trained professionals in this field in hospitals, clinics, healthcare institutions and the fitness sector. Therefore, continuing the course is important not only for students but also for society.
The students further stated that they had enrolled in the programme with their future in mind and had invested significant time, effort and financial resources in their education. They said that stopping the course midway or leaving its future uncertain would amount to jeopardising their careers. According to the students, such uncertainty could negatively affect their employment prospects and also impact the expectations of their families.
Through their application, the students urged the university administration to take a positive decision on the matter at the earliest and ensure that the course is resumed and conducted smoothly. They also appealed to the university to give top priority to the interests of students and take necessary steps to protect their academic and career prospects.
Student leader Piyush Pujara also expressed his views on the issue. He said, “Stopping an important and employment-oriented course like Clinical Nutrition and Dietetics or keeping its future uncertain is completely wrong. This is directly related to the future of students. We demand that the university administration immediately restart the course, keeping the concerns and future of the students in mind.”
He further said, “Students have invested their hard work and resources in this course. Therefore, they have the right to receive a clear and positive direction regarding their future.”
The students expressed confidence that the university administration would take their concerns seriously and provide relief by taking a concrete decision soon. For now, students are waiting for the university administration’s next decision on the matter.

90i_news.title: Purnea University Extends UG Semester-IV Admission Deadline to August 26
90i_news.author: 90I डिजिटल डेस्क
tags: Purnea University has extended the UG Semester-IV admission deadline for the 2024–28 session to August 26
90i_news.excerpt: Purnea University has extended the UG Semester-IV admission deadline for the 2024–28 session to August 26, 2026. Students who have not yet completed their admission are advised to complete the process within the revised deadline and follow the instructions issued by the university and their respective colleges.
90i_news.content:
Purnia: Purnea University has extended the deadline for admission to the UG Semester-IV programme for the 2024–28 session. According to the latest university notice, eligible students can now complete their Semester-IV admission process up to August 26, 2026.

The university has issued an official notice regarding the extension of the admission date. The decision is expected to provide additional time to students who were unable to complete their admission within the earlier deadline.

Students enrolled in the 2024–28 undergraduate session have been advised to complete the required admission formalities within the extended deadline. The university has also issued separate notices related to UG Semester-IV registration and course-selection-cum-semester registration.

The extension is particularly important for students who have not yet completed their Semester-IV admission process. Students are advised to check the instructions applicable to their respective colleges and complete the process without waiting for the last date.

The latest notice comes after the university had earlier scheduled the Semester-IV admission process for the 2024–28 session. The deadline has now been extended to August 26, 2026, giving students another opportunity to complete their admission.

Students should keep the required documents and admission-related details ready and contact their respective colleges in case they face any difficulty during the process.

The university has advised students to follow the official instructions and complete the admission formalities within the revised deadline.
